correctness.rationale: For n>=7, any Rips clique extending beyond adjacent columns has a distance-two column pair e_{j,a} with identical row a and unique intermediate column j. Its complete link is the middle-column triangle at rows a−1,a,a+1. Distinct long-pair stars cannot coexist; removing four explicitly ordered free/coface pairs in each star gives 20n elementary collapses onto the cyclic union of two-column slabs P_j. For C5×K2 each ten-vertex slab has 123 faces including empty; individually verified all 48 exact collapse pairs in actual local_sphere_collapse.json, each lower face free, and obtained the exact listed residual 6-vertex octahedral S² face complex. The n slabs have only pairwise full-simplex intersections for adjacent columns and no triple intersections, giving a circle and n two-spheres via cyclic homotopy colimit/cofibration gluing. Scale-one graph has 5n vertices, 10n edges and H1=Z^{5n+1}; row-fixed column cycle maps onto the necklace S¹, so kernel primitive rank5n. Independent exhaustive Rips face enumeration and all 20n free-pair removals for n=7,8,9 agreed (918/1049/1180 initial faces; 140/160/180 collapses; residual exact slab union). All n follows from symbolic link classification, not finite extrapolation.
